recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of three women with voluminous 1980s hairstyles, wearing dark sequined outfits against a black background, framed by a distinct horizontal header containing bold, stylized typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The magenta header creates a heavy visual weight at the top that anchors the composition.
The three subjects are arranged in a triangular formation, with the central figure slightly higher.
The yellow secondary text provides a sharp color contrast against the monochromatic photo area.
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography for the subjects.
A solid black background that merges with the subjects' clothing.
A horizontal dividing line separating the header from the image.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three women occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up in a tight, overlapping group.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized magenta title in the top third of the layout.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large magenta title, drop to the yellow subtitle on the left, and then scan the three faces from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space surrounds the subjects, emphasizing their silhouettes and the texture of their hair.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white photography defines the primary visual texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black background provides maximum contrast for the subjects and the yellow text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta (header) and bright yellow (subtitle) provide pop-art accents.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value white highlights on skin and sequins against zero-value black, paired with high-saturation neon-adjacent colors.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to black, white, magenta, and yellow.

letterConstructionRules: The main title uses extremely tight kerning (touching or overlapping).
The first letter of the title is significantly oversized, acting as a container for smaller text.
Secondary text uses a rounded, bold sans-serif with a slight italic lean.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'C' is enlarged to wrap around the word 'The'.
Serifs on the main title are sharp and elongated.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a sophisticated, tight-tracked serif and a friendly, rounded sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif and sharp terminals of the display text.
Matches the rounded, friendly geometry of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of three women with 1980s big hair and sequined black tops against a black background. Leave the top 30% of the image as a solid black block separated by a thin white horizontal line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the top black block, add the main title in magenta using a bold, high-contrast serif font with overlapping letters. In the upper left of the photo area, add the subtitle in bright yellow using a bold rounded sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the title text magenta and overlapping?
Is the photo high-contrast black and white?
Is there a clear horizontal line separating the header?
Is the subtitle yellow and left-aligned?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or existing band logos.
Ensure the three women are generic models, not specific celebrities.

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp graphic division between text and image

postGenerationChecks: Check that the magenta header is perfectly horizontal.
Verify that the yellow text is legible against the black background.
Ensure the hair textures are crisp and detailed.
Confirm the triangular composition of the subjects.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W trio portrait + Solid color header block + Overlapping serif display type + Rounded sans-serif accent type.
